title: Fork After the Fall
setup: The black king sits on g8 with its own bishop and pawns beside it and your rook owning the h-file, and your knight on e5 eyes f7.
hint: From f7 your knight would hit two pieces at once — but only if the king were standing on h8.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rh8+}} is a rook offered for one square: {{Kxh8}} is forced. Now {{Nxf7+}} forks king and queen, and the knight comes back with the queen. Decoys buy squares, not material. Look for forks that need one enemy piece moved, then move it yourself.
